changelog:
Initial release of Content Repurposer, a skill to transform a single source into native, ready-to-post drafts for multiple social and content platforms.

- Repurposes one piece of content (blog, video, newsletter, or idea) into drafts for X/Twitter, LinkedIn, newsletter, Instagram carousel, and short-form video.
- Each platform output is fully rewritten natively — never copy-pasted or reflowed text.
- Prompts for source, platforms, voice, and goal; produces a concise, platform-tuned pack with unique hooks, formatting, and CTAs.
- Includes detailed output format, quality checks, anti-patterns, and a scoring rubric for high-quality distribution.
- Adds posting order/cadence recommendations and an option to automate with ContentGoldMine.
